cues.en: This will be a pretty short video and code demo, as I'm sure you guessed from the title.

cues.en: I'm going to show you how to completely bypass one of the transformer blocks.
cues.zh: 我要展示，如何完全繞過其中一個 Transformer 區塊。

cues.en: To be honest, I'm not sure if this approach really has a lot of application value because it's a pretty coarse lesion, but maybe it does have some use.

cues.en: And anyway, it's a good opportunity to help solidify your understanding of the meaning of the inputs into the hook functions.
cues.zh: 總之，這是加深你對 hook 函數輸入意義之理解的好機會。

cues.en: So the idea is that the output from each transformer block is the input to the next transformer block.
cues.zh: 概念是，每個 Transformer 區塊的輸出，就是下一個區塊的輸入。

cues.en: What I will show you in this code demo is how to bypass a block completely, such that the output of
cues.zh: 這個程式示範要展示，如何完全繞過一個區塊，讓

cues.en: block T ends up being the input into block T plus two.
cues.zh: 區塊 T 的輸出，成為區塊 T+2 的輸入。

cues.en: Technically, PyTorch is still going to do all of the calculations in block T plus one, but the hook
cues.zh: 技術上，PyTorch 仍然會執行區塊 T+1 的全部計算，但我植入的 hook，

cues.en: that I will implant will replace the output of T plus one with the output of T, and that means that
cues.zh: 會用 T 的輸出，替換 T+1 的輸出。這代表，

cues.en: all the calculations that were done in this transformer block were all for nothing.
cues.zh: 這個 Transformer 區塊中的所有計算，全都白做了。

cues.zh: 程式碼長這樣。

cues.zh: 我產生一些文字，讓模型做前向傳播，儲存隱藏狀態，接著

cues.en: And you see that from 6 to 5 we have a norm of zero which means the embeddings vectors did not change at all as it passed through this layer.
cues.zh: 可以看到，從 6 到 5，範數是零，代表嵌入向量通過這一層時，完全沒有改變。

cues.en: And remember that all of the hidden states actually includes the embeddings matrix as as zero.
cues.zh: 記得，所有隱藏狀態中，零號其實是嵌入矩陣。

cues.en: So layer five of the transformer block actually corresponds to layer six in the hidden states.
cues.zh: 所以，Transformer 第五號區塊，實際對應隱藏狀態的第六號層。

cues.zh: 基本上，就是無論模型或這一層的輸入是什麼，所有

cues.en: The beautiful thing about forward hooks and causal mcinturff research is that it allows you to do really precise ablations and manipulations.
cues.zh: forward hook 與因果機制可解釋性研究很棒的一點，是能做非常精確的消融與操作。

cues.en: Cutting out an entire transformer block is much more like a chainsaw than a surgical knife.
cues.zh: 但切掉整個 Transformer 區塊，更像使用鏈鋸，而不是手術刀。

cues.en: So I'm not sure how often you would actually want to do something like this in practice.
cues.zh: 所以，我不確定實務上，會有多常真的想這樣做。
